sudo mkdir -p /opt/inventory-app && sudo tee /opt/inventory-app/app.py > /dev/null <<'PYEOF'
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "WH-1001", "name": "Wireless Headphones", "qty": 42, "location": "A1"},
    {"sku": "SB-2002", "name": "Standing Desk", "qty": 7, "location": "B3"},
    {"sku": "MK-3003", "name": "Mechanical Keyboard", "qty": 118, "location": "A4"},
    {"sku": "LM-4004", "name": "27in Monitor", "qty": 23, "location": "C2"},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path in ("/", "/inventory"):
            body = json.dumps({"inventory": INVENTORY}, indent=2).encode()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8181), Handler).serve_forever()
PYEOF
